lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Real ~90.5 deg fold where the neck of the T base plate (outer skin patch 1) turns into the riser (patch 4). In perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the label point sits on the outermost outer-skin point of the rounded fold (outermost u at v~0 is -0.00/-0.01/-0.02 mm; nearest scan point 0.03/0.05/0.24 mm). The line is parallel to the fold, with the plane fits at rms ~0.006 mm. It runs t=0 to 23.3 mm, and the visible fold spans about t=-1.1 to 23.9 mm including the rounded perimeter corners, so it covers about 93% of the fold, which passes the 80% rule.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Real ~90.2 deg fold where the riser (outer skin patch 3) turns back into the top tab (patch 5), parallel to the base plate, forming a Z / joggle with B1. In sections at 25/50/75% the label point sits on the outer apex (outermost u -0.05/-0.01/0.00 mm; nearest point 0.09/0.16/0.14 mm). At 50% the tab hole wall shows up in the section, but it is away from the apex and does not affect the line. The line runs t=0 to 23.7 mm, and the fold spans about t=-0.6 to 24.4 mm, so it covers about 95% of the fold.
